name: ZeptoLab
description:
ZeptoLab is a global mobile gaming company dedicated to the science of fun. It all began in 2010 with two people and one cheerful green monster — Om Nom, whose love for candies sparked the creation of the iconic Cut the Rope franchise. Since then, Cut the Rope games have been downloaded more than 1.2 billion times.

Today, ZeptoLab focuses on its flagship live title Bullet Echo, enjoyed by millions of players worldwide. Alongside it, we continue to develop and expand the Cut the Rope universe — one of the most recognized and beloved mobile gaming IPs in the world.

jobs.title: General Counsel
jobs.description:
At ZeptoLab, we're looking for a General Counsel to become a trusted legal partner for the business and help navigate complex legal matters across multiple international jurisdictions.

This is a hands-on senior role for a broad legal generalist who enjoys solving diverse legal challenges, partnering with business leaders, and driving operational excellence through AI and modern legal technologies.

What you'll do

  • Advise the business on corporate, commercial and regulatory matters across multiple jurisdictions, with a particular focus on the UK.
  • Draft, negotiate and manage a wide range of commercial agreements, including publishing, licensing, IP, SaaS, procurement and strategic partnerships.
  • Partner with business leaders by identifying legal risks, providing pragmatic recommendations and supporting informed business decisions.
  • Support cross-border legal projects, corporate governance and international compliance.
  • Manage intellectual property matters, including trademarks, copyrights, licensing and IP protection.
  • Drive GDPR compliance, privacy governance, data processing agreements and cross-border data transfers.
  • Continuously improve contract management, legal documentation standards and legal operations.
  • Support statutory audits, due diligence projects and regulatory reviews.
  • Introduce AI-powered legal workflows and automation for contract drafting, legal research, document review, compliance monitoring and knowledge management.
  • Collaborate with external legal advisors across different jurisdictions.

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience as a senior in-house legal counsel or general counsel in an international company.
  • Proven in-house legal experience in the game development industry.
  • Broad international legal experience across multiple jurisdictions, with strong expertise in UK corporate and commercial law.
  • Strong experience with commercial contracts, licensing and intellectual property.
  • Ability to quickly navigate unfamiliar jurisdictions by working effectively with external counsel when needed.
  • Business-oriented mindset — you can clearly communicate legal risks while understanding that business leaders make the final decisions.
  • Strong ownership and willingness to take responsibility beyond a narrow area of expertise.
  • Passion for improving legal processes through AI and modern legal technologies.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Fluency in both English and Russian would be considered an advantage.

Why this role is interesting

  • The chance to expand your expertise across multiple international jurisdictions.
  • Broad exposure to high-impact legal work spanning corporate, commercial, IP, licensing, privacy and compliance.
  • An opportunity to shape how AI is integrated into legal operations and build a modern legal function.
  • Direct access to founders and senior leadership, with the ability to influence strategic business decisions.


As part of the recruitment process, we will need to process your personal data in order to review your application and communicate with you. You can find more information about how we handle your data in our Recruitment Privacy Notice at https://zeptolab.com/recruitment-privacy-notice.

jobs.title: Generalist Artist
jobs.description:
At ZeptoLab, we're looking for a Senior Generalist Artist to join our team, working across our established titles and new game projects.

This is a hands-on role for a versatile artist who is equally comfortable working across 3D and 2D, implementing their work in Unity, and shaping the visual direction of a game. 

What you'll do

  • Create, iterate and implement 2D/3D/UI assets, animations and VFX in Unity for mobile games.
  • Help establish and maintain the visual style of new game concepts.
  • Work closely with Game Designers and Developers from early prototypes through production.
  • Turn gameplay ideas and design requirements into clear and effective visual solutions.
  • Iterate rapidly based on gameplay feedback, performance requirements and player needs.
  • Contribute your own visual ideas and proactively suggest solutions.
  • Estimate, prioritise and plan your work to support fast-paced prototyping and production.

What we're looking for

  • Strong experience in both 3D and 2D game art.
  • Hands-on experience implementing art assets in Unity.
  • Good understanding of mobile optimization and performance considerations.
  • Strong understanding of composition, readability and visual hierarchy.
  • Experience working on mobile games; Hybrid Casual, Casual or Hypercasual experience would be a plus.
  • Experience with AI tools in the creative workflow or a strong willingness to explore and adopt new AI tools.
  • Experience taking games or game features from prototype to production; shipped games would be a plus.
  • A strong hands-on approach — you enjoy creating and iterating yourself, rather than focusing only on art direction or management.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership and make decisions in an environment with a high degree of autonomy.
  • A fast iteration and prototyping mindset.

Why this role is interesting

  • A highly hands-on and creative role with a lot of freedom, ownership and autonomy.
  • The chance to work across 3D, 2D and Unity rather than being limited to one area of art.
  • The opportunity to work on new game concepts from the very early prototype stage and see how they evolve based on gameplay and player feedback.

As part of the recruitment process, we will need to process your personal data in order to review your application and communicate with you. You can find more information about how we handle your data in our Recruitment Privacy Notice at https://zeptolab.com/recruitment-privacy-notice.

jobs.title: Open application
jobs.description:
Don't see any roles currently listed that interest you? No problem. We are always on the lookout for talented and passionate people, so if you feel like you got what it takes to join the Zeptolab family, submit an open application! We will contact you when we have a relevant job opening for you.

Why join us:

  • We do something magical and unique – we create great games – and we do it well;
  • We operate in a challenging and rapidly growing mobile gaming industry;
  • ZeptoTeam - is a cohesive team of enthusiastic professionals - so your input will be heard, and your role in the project will be weighty;
  • Diversity and inclusion are important to us. ZeptoLab is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or disability;
  • And at last – we'll offer you an attractive compensation package (from wages to social intangible elements. Package includes medical insurance, meals, travel, fitness, mobile payments, payment of tourist trips and a lot of additional services).

As part of the recruitment process, we will need to process your personal data in order to review your application and communicate with you. You can find more information about how we handle your data in our Recruitment Privacy Notice at https://zeptolab.com/recruitment-privacy-notice.
